translation: In the name of God, the Gracious, the Merciful
Praise be to God, Lord of the Worlds
The Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
Master of the Day of Judgment
It is You we worship, and upon You we call for help
Guide us to the straight path

arabic: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
translation: The path of those You have blessed, not of those against whom there is anger, nor of those who are misguided
